'''Lu Xiyun''' ({{zh|s=陆夕云}}; born April 1963) is a Chinese physicist currently serving as director of the School of Engineering Science, [[University of Science and Technology of China]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://ses.ustc.edu.cn/2017/1214/c1688a213947/page.psp |script-title=zh:工程科学学院执行院长陆夕云为近代力学系宣讲十九大精神 |work=ustc.edu.cn |date=14 December 2017 |access-date=23 November 2019 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Biography==
Lu was born in [[Taizhou, Jiangsu]] in April 1963. He completed his doctor's degree from the [[University of Science and Technology of China]] in 1992.<ref name="fish">{{cite news|url=http://news.sina.com.cn/o/2019-11-22/doc-iihnzahi2720174.shtml |script-title=zh:陆夕云：力学攀登者 |work=sina |date=22 November 2019 |access-date=23 November 2019 |language=zh}}</ref>

He was a visiting scholar at [[Pennsylvania State University]], [[University of Houston]], [[University of Tennessee]], [[University of Tokyo]], [[Northeastern University]], [[Hong Kong University of Science and Technology]] and [[National University of Singapore]] since 1992.

He is now the director of the School of Engineering Science, University of Science and Technology of China.

==Honours and awards==
* "[[Changjiang Scholars Program|Chang Jiang Scholar]]" (or "Yangtze River Scholar") 
* November 22, 2019 Academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS)<ref>{{cite news|url=https://news.ifeng.com/c/7rnt6gRXMxD |script-title=zh:2019年中科院院士增选结果揭晓，64人当选，最小年龄42岁 |work=ifeng |date=22 November 2019 |access-date=22 November 2019 |language=zh}}</ref>
